findings.evidenceJa: いずれ敵になるって話
findings.governingReading: the understanding that they would eventually become enemies
findings.explanation: A conditional future relationship is hardened into an explicit mutual promise to fight.

findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺か間桐邸に忍び込んで
findings.governingReading: infiltrate either Ryuudou Temple or the Matou residence
findings.explanation: One of Shirou’s two planned investigation sites disappears.
The evidentiary certainty Shirou needs is reduced to general usefulness.

findings.highlight: a few day’s worth of groceries
findings.explanation: The plural duration is given an incorrect singular possessive.

findings.governingReading: whoever the intruder was, without known gender
findings.explanation: The intruder is assigned male gender before Shirou has identified anyone.

findings.highlight: Calmly think, and I can tell
findings.evidenceJa: 冷静になって考えれば
findings.governingReading: if he calms down and thinks, he can read what happened
findings.explanation: The English turns a failed conditional effort into a malformed imperative.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺にだけ都合のいい話
findings.governingReading: a story convenient only for Shirou
findings.explanation: The selfish asymmetry driving his guilt is omitted.

findings.governingReading: let’s settle this once and for all
findings.explanation: The idiom for resolving their conflict becomes unnatural tournament language.
A loss whose final ontological status remains uncertain is stated as elimination.

findings.highlight: don’t try to pull any shit with me
findings.evidenceJa: 下手な考えは起こすな
findings.governingReading: do not entertain any foolish scheme
findings.explanation: Shinji’s warning is made substantially more vulgar and aggressive.

findings.governingReading: the incidents moved dismissal time earlier
findings.explanation: A changed student schedule becomes closure of the institution.

findings.highlight: there are no students or teachers
findings.evidenceJa: 残ってはいないだろう
findings.governingReading: there are probably no students or even teachers remaining
findings.explanation: Shirou’s expectation is promoted into observed certainty.

findings.highlight: He has to be in the classroom on the third floor
findings.evidenceJa: あいつがいるとすれば三階の教室だ
findings.governingReading: if Shinji is anywhere, it will be the third-floor classroom
findings.explanation: A character-based prediction is made necessary fact.

findings.highlight: I read its course with amazing speed and avoid it
findings.evidenceJa: 自分でも驚くほどの先読みで躱した
findings.governingReading: he evades through anticipation so acute it surprises even himself
findings.explanation: Predictive combat reading is changed into processing speed.

findings.governingReading: he believes he has seized the opening
findings.explanation: The abrupt English implies successful capture of Shinji before Shirou even reaches the Command Spell.

findings.highlight: My tongue bulges from my mouth
findings.governingReading: his tongue protrudes or stretches out under strangulation
findings.explanation: The choking reaction is changed from extension to swelling.
